tool.name: Spyogenes Typing
tool.description: emm, emm cluster and pattern, MLST, M1UK, superantigens, resistance and FCT of Streptococcus pyogenes assemblies
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/spyogenes_typing.py' --db '$__tool_directory__/database' --fofn '$fofn' --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if str($allele_layout) == 'combined' --combine-alleles #elif str($allele_layout) == 'none' --no-alleles #end if --minid $adv.minid #if $adv.want_json --json '$json_out' #end if #if $adv.want_hits --hits '$hits_out' #end if --outfile '$report'

param.name: input
param.label: Assemblies
param.help: One or more S. pyogenes assemblies (FASTA, GenBank or EMBL), or a collection. Sample names come from the dataset/element names.

param.name: allele_layout
param.label: MLST allele layout
param.option: One column per allele (ALLELE1 to ALLELE7)
No allele columns (only ST and MLST status)

param.name: minid
param.label: Minimum % identity of a full-length allele to name it (emm, MLST)

param.name: want_hits
param.label: Also output every hit (closest allele per place, identity, position)

has_line.line: Sample Species check emm emm status emmL emmCG emm cluster emm pattern ST ALLELE1 ALLELE2 ALLELE3 ALLELE4 ALLELE5 ALLELE6 ALLELE7 MLST status M1 lineage Superantigens Resistance genes FCT type Warnings Database

tool.help:
**What it does**
Types *Streptococcus pyogenes* (group A *Streptococcus*) assemblies with PubMLST's data and PubMLST's own typing rules (guide *Rules-based assignment of emm and pilin genotypes for group A streptococci*, Feb 2024). One row per assembly:
- **emm** type and subtype (e.g. ``emm1.0``), emm-like genes (emmL) and *S. dysgalactiae* emm genes (emmCG) - **emm cluster** (Sanderson-Smith 2014) and **emm pattern** (A-E, REA) - **MLST** sequence type and alleles - **M1 lineage** for emm1: M1UK, M1intermediate, M1DK or M1global - **superantigen** genes and PubMLST **resistance** genes - **FCT type**: FCT-region form and pilin type (the T-antigen pilus region)
**Columns**
================= ========================================================== Species check ``S. pyogenes`` when 6 or more of the 7 MLST loci are found at 95% identity or more; otherwise check the species emm emm allele at the emm locus (the hit just after the emmPrime marker); ``emm1`` without subtype when cut by a contig end emm status PERFECT, NOVEL (nearest allele shown), PARTIAL (contig end), MULTICOPY, MIXED, MISSING emmL / emmCG emm-like and stG/stC emm genes elsewhere in the genome emm cluster E1-E6, D1-D5, A-C1 to A-C5, clade_X/Y singletons, outliers emm pattern measured from the mga/SF markers next to emm (A, B, C throat; D skin; E generalist; REA rearranged), or ``(predicted)`` from the emm type when the markers cannot all be seen ST, ALLELE1..7 MLST; ``~4`` not exact, ``4?`` partial, ``-`` missing MLST status PERFECT, NOVEL, PARTIAL, MULTICOPY, MIXED, MISSING, BAD, NONE M1 lineage emm1 only: number of M1UK SNPs out of 27 Superantigens speA, speC, speG, speH, speI, speJ, speK, speL, speM, smeZ, ssa Resistance genes e.g. ``ermB(1)``; ``~`` not exact, ``?`` partial FCT type e.g. ``FCT-4 (pil028)``: form from rofA/nra and the pilA/pilB loci, pilin type from their nt80 clusters Warnings anything to check Database database version ================= ==========================================================
**Database**
PubMLST *S. pyogenes* typing data (https://pubmlst.org/organisms/streptococcus-pyogenes): the standard, freely available data, **submitted up to 31 December 2024**, which is the part PubMLST gives without an account. emm data are curated by the CDC. Superantigen genes from NCBI RefSeq genomes; M1UK SNPs from Lynskey et al. 2019. The database version is on every row of the report.
**Source and documentation**
https://github.com/TinusTK/spyogenes-typing, which explains every column, how the PubMLST rules are applied, and the validation against PubMLST's own isolate records. Please cite the tool and PubMLST (see Citations below).
